pr_body:
##### Summary
Fixes #10741 

This PR adds monitoring for more syscalls related to synchronization.

##### Component Name
ebpf.plugin

##### Test Plan

1 - Compile the Branch and start Netdata after this
2 - Compile this [example](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/files/6174427/tester.txt) and run it. When the software finalize you will have all charts with data.

##### Additional Information

This PR was tested on:

| Linux Distribution | kernels |
|------------------------|-------------|
| Slackware current | 5.11.2 |
| Slackware current | 5.10.24 |
| Slackware current | 5.4.95 |
| Ubuntu 18.04 | 5.4.66 |
| Ubuntu 18.04 | 4.15 |
| CentOS | 3.10.0 |

issue_context.title: Complement for `sync` monitoring
issue_context.body: As discussed [here](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/issues/10725#issuecomment-794000014) and well defined [here](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/pull/10726#issuecomment-794008441), to bring the `sync` monitoring is not solving completely our user  problems,  we need to bring more `syscalls` monitoring to `netdata` to correct measure performance bottlenecks.
